description.to:
Generated ideas come from ranked context packs built by deterministic, statistical signals over recent human activity (Messages, comments, votes with reasons, published stories), the knowledge graph (related_to links between References and from References to concept wiki entries, shown as hashtags) and vector suggestions that editors accept or reject. Every Reference carries two dates: original publication and ingestion.

Why: on 2026-11-01 monitor-stories filed 0 ideas on all seven sites; it only drafts from accepted, monitor-delivered, undrafted References and reads none of the curation signals. Ideas should be about themes, not single items.

Ryan's decisions (2026-11-01):
1. Tagging a Reference with a concept means it relates to that concept: a related_to edge (reference -> semanticNode). No new predicate.
2. Pending References may appear in packs as 'not yet accepted' context, never as cited evidence.
3. Single-item ideas keep running beside packs, to find individual items worth a post, but are chosen by signals; both are balanced by the same signal score.
4. Accept/Reject everywhere (References, link and concept suggestions, ideas) offers the optional reason; reasons train the site Cyclotrons; one shared Accept/Reject-with-reason component.

Stories: S1 ideas flow again (packs + signal-ranked single items; router release only), S2 links/concepts/suggestions + shared decision UI (site batch deploy), S3 two dates, S4 learning (with PPY-c6aced). Full design in the first comment; docs/idea-context-packs.md once S1.0 lands. Related: PPY-9ff95b (automation), PPY-c6aced (Cyclotron learning loop), PPY-781d26 (Messages from people).

Acceptance criteria for the epic: every story closed with its checks met; every site files theme ideas from its own signals with config only; Gherkin specs for every behaviour change.
